skill.name: Maven Build Lifecycle Execution
skill.description: Execute Maven build phases in proper sequence, understanding phase dependencies and orchestrating the complete build lifecycle from compile through deploy.
skill.skill_body:
Invoke this skill when you need to run a Maven build and ensure all lifecycle phases execute in the correct order. Maven's build lifecycle consists of phases that must run sequentially: validate, compile, test, package, verify, install, and deploy. Use this skill to understand which phases are executed, their dependencies, and how to target specific phases or the full lifecycle.

## Objective

Execute Maven build phases in proper order with all prior phases completed
## Applicable Signals

- User initiates mvn command with lifecycle phase target
- Build requires validation of phase execution order
- Downstream artifacts depend on prior phases completing

## Contraindications

- Configuring individual plugin goals or plugin-specific behavior
- Debugging plugin execution failures or plugin parameter issues
- Customizing site generation or documentation build steps

## Workflow Steps

- Identify the target lifecycle phase (compile, test, package, verify, install, deploy)
- Confirm all prerequisite phases will execute in order
- Execute the Maven command targeting the desired phase
- Monitor phase completion and artifact generation
- Verify all expected build artifacts are produced

## Constraints

- Phases must execute in Maven's defined sequence
- All prior phases in the lifecycle must complete before later phases
- Phase execution is atomic within the lifecycle context

## Cautions

- Skipping phases may result in incomplete builds or missing artifacts
- Phase execution order cannot be reordered; it is fixed by Maven's lifecycle definition

## Output Contract

- Successful execution of the requested lifecycle phase(s) with all prior phases completed; build artifacts generated and available for downstream use or deployment.
